title: Electrothermal strip, voltage drive (analytic sigma_dc(T) fixed point)
description:
A 1 mm metal strip whose resistivity rises linearly with T (sigma_dc = sigma0 / (1 + beta (T - T0))) is heated by its own current and cooled by its cold ends.
Analytic: T_max - T0 = s / (sqrt(1 + beta s) + 1), s = sigma0 V0^2 / (4 k); theta = [cos(m (x - L/2)) / cos(m L / 2) - 1] / beta, m L / 2 = atan(sqrt(beta s)).
Derived values tab: T_max, dT_max, T_probe, I_drive and P_joule against the closed form (relative errors ~1e-4 or below).
Line profile tab: T_profile or V_profile (the S-shaped potential).
Sweep tab: dT_max and I_drive versus V0 (0.05..0.3 V) with their references, plus dT_const_sigma = s, the rise without the resistive feedback.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: drive voltage in V (x_lo face at V0, x_hi face at 0 V; the sweep runs V0 = 0.05..0.3 V)

parameters.name: L
parameters.description: strip length along x (between the cold, grounded / driven ends)

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: strip width along y (insulated faces: the problem is 1D in x)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (200 cells along the strip)

parameters.name: sigma0
parameters.description: DC conductivity at T0 in S/m (platinum-like)

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: temperature coefficient of resistivity in 1/K: rho = rho0 (1 + beta (T - T0))

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: temperature of both strip ends and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: s_drive
parameters.description: rise scale s in K: T_max - T0 = s / 2 for a constant conductivity, s / (sqrt(1 + beta s) + 1) with the feedback

parameters.name: mL_half
parameters.description: m L / 2 of the cosine profile (rad), always < pi/2: a voltage drive never runs away

parameters.name: m_v
parameters.description: wavenumber m of the cosine temperature profile in 1/m

parameters.name: dT_ref
parameters.description: analytic peak rise T_max - T0 in K

parameters.name: J_ref
parameters.description: analytic current density in A/m^2 (sigma0 V0 / L without feedback)

parameters.name: I_ref
parameters.description: analytic current per m of depth in A/m

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: temperature probe x: the cell centre just right of the strip centre

parameters.name: T_probe_ref
parameters.description: analytic temperature at the probe in K
